title: Replace Airtable With a Custom Tool Built in an Afternoon (Save $240+/Year)
summary: Replace Airtable and stop paying $20/user/month. Here's how teams build a custom database app in one afternoon — no developer, no per-seat fees, same features.
body_markdown: Blink-built apps run on production infrastructure — not a prototype sandbox. Hosting is included, and the apps are deployed to real servers with uptime commitments. Teams that have replaced Airtable with custom Blink tools use them as primary internal tools, not experiments. That said: Airtable has a decade of uptime history and enterprise SLAs. If you need a signed 99.99% SLA with a support phone number, Airtable's Enterprise tier is the right answer.
